cohort: Ten preterm infants with a gestational age of 25-30 weeks and birthweight of 630-1750 g.
finding: A gestational-age-dependent microbial signature was observed, with very preterm infants developing a Bifidobacterium-dominated community associated with carbohydrate and energy metabolism, while extremely preterm infants remained colonized by facultative anaerobes associated with membrane transport and translation.
